g.title: OxCidationExperiment
g.text: OxCidation experiment flow - agent and module perspective

g.title: cluster_preparation
g.text: PHASE A - ONCE PER C PROGRAM: PREPARE SHARED VISIBLE EVIDENCE

g.title: cluster_prompt_run
g.text: PHASE B - ONCE PER PROGRAM x PROMPT: TRANSLATE, REPAIR AND EVALUATE

g.title: start
g.text: Select C programs, prompts, model and seed

g.title: deterministic
g.text: Compile C; run each input twice
Reject duplicates, failures, timeouts and unstable output

g.title: suite_review
g.text: Review C + surviving inputs + deterministic report
No Rust, problem statement or Judge data

g.title: prompt_entry
g.text: For each program x translation prompt
Reuse the same frozen or disabled suite state

g.title: translate
g.text: Preserve raw response and Rust source

g.title: compile
g.text: Compile failure may request bounded repair

g.title: visible_run
g.text: Run C and Rust on the shared visible suite

g.title: final_judge
g.text: After pass, skip, invalid test or inconclusive evidence
Run or reuse final Judge comparison and case counts

g.title: semantic_repair
g.text: Apply repair, then recompile and rerun tests

g.title: reports
g.text: CSV + JSON + attempt history + agent interactions
